text_markup: {term:Core damage counters} are a gameplay aid used to track core damage the Runner has suffered. Each point of core damage the Runner suffers forces them to take a core damage counter. See {ref:sec_damage}.
text_plain: Core damage counters are a gameplay aid used to track core damage the Runner has suffered. Each point of core damage the Runner suffers forces them to take a core damage counter. See section 10.4.
